description: Normalized catalog of Pokemon Ribbons listed as obtainable in the Smogon Ribbon Master Guide, including their origin generation, origin games, acquisition requirements, transfer behavior, and HOME title where applicable.

source.note: Aligned with the obtainable ribbons listed in the Smogon Ribbon Master Guide. Ribbons are grouped only when every member shares the same origin and acquisition pattern; Contest Memory and Battle Memory visual variants remain nested under their base ribbon entries.

scope.included: Obtainable Generation III through Generation VIII Ribbons listed in the Smogon Ribbon Master Guide, including transferable GameCube side-series Ribbons.
scope.excluded: Generation V event ribbons, Generation IX ribbons, deprecated Ribbon data slots, unavailable event distributions, Pokemon HOME challenges, Marks, and spin-off-only Ribbons without a documented transfer path to Pokemon HOME.
scope.memory_conversion: Generation III and IV Contest and Battle Tower Ribbons are individually retained through Generation V, then collapse into a Contest Memory Ribbon or Battle Memory Ribbon when transferred to Generation VI.

ribbon_groups.title: Hoenn and Kanto League
ribbon_groups.acquisition: Enter the Hall of Fame after defeating the Pokemon League.

ribbon_groups.title: Hoenn Contests
ribbon_groups.acquisition: Win the named Hoenn Pokemon Contest category and rank. Normal, Super, and Hyper rank contests are in Verdanturf, Fallarbor, and Slateport in Ruby/Sapphire; Emerald uses Lilycove for all ranks. Master Rank is in Lilycove.

ribbon_groups.title: Hoenn Battle Tower
ribbon_groups.acquisition: Win a seven-battle set that extends the relevant Hoenn Battle Tower streak to 56 or more wins.

ribbons.name: Winning Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Lv. 50 challenge in Ruby/Sapphire, or Level 50 challenge in Emerald.

ribbons.name: Victory Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Lv. 100 challenge in Ruby/Sapphire, or Open Level challenge in Emerald.

ribbons.name: Effort Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Reach 510 total effort values.

ribbons.name: Artist Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Hoenn Master Rank or Link Contest with a high score and accept the Lilycove Museum portrait offer.

ribbons.name: National Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Purify a Shadow Pokemon in Pokemon Colosseum or Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness.

ribbons.name: Earth Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win 100 consecutive Mt. Battle matches with the Pokemon in the party.

ribbon_groups.title: Sinnoh League
ribbon_groups.acquisition: Defeat the Sinnoh Champion and enter the Sinnoh Hall of Fame.

ribbon_groups.title: Sinnoh Super Contests
ribbon_groups.acquisition: Win the named category and rank at the Hearthome City Super Contest Hall.

ribbons.name: Ability Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat Palmer on battle 21 of a Battle Tower Single Battle streak.

ribbons.name: Great Ability Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat Palmer on battle 49 of a Battle Tower Single Battle streak.

ribbons.name: Double Ability Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Complete the Battle Tower Double challenge.

ribbons.name: Multi Ability Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Complete the Battle Tower Multi challenge with an NPC partner.

ribbons.name: Pair Ability Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Complete the Battle Tower Link Multi challenge.

ribbons.name: World Ability Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a qualifying Wi-Fi Room Battle Tower set.

ribbons.name: Alert Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Receive on Monday.

ribbons.name: Shock Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Receive on Tuesday.

ribbons.name: Downcast Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Receive on Wednesday.

ribbons.name: Careless Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Receive on Thursday.

ribbons.name: Relax Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Receive on Friday.

ribbons.name: Snooze Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Receive on Saturday.

ribbons.name: Smile Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Receive on Sunday.

ribbons.name: Gorgeous Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Purchase for 10,000 Poke Dollars.

ribbons.name: Royal Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Purchase for 100,000 Poke Dollars after obtaining the Gorgeous Ribbon.

ribbons.name: Gorgeous Royal Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Purchase for 999,999 Poke Dollars after obtaining the Royal Ribbon.

ribbons.name: Footprint Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Meet Dr. Footstep's eligibility condition; this varies by game.

ribbons.name: Legend Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat Red at Mt. Silver with the Pokemon in the party.

ribbons.name: Kalos Champion Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Enter the Kalos Hall of Fame.

ribbons.name: Hoenn Champion Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Enter the Hoenn Hall of Fame in Omega Ruby or Alpha Sapphire.

ribbons.name: Coolness Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Master Rank Coolness Contest Spectacular.

ribbons.name: Beauty Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Master Rank Beauty Contest Spectacular.

ribbons.name: Cuteness Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Master Rank Cuteness Contest Spectacular.

ribbons.name: Cleverness Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Master Rank Cleverness Contest Spectacular.

ribbons.name: Toughness Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Master Rank Toughness Contest Spectacular.

ribbons.name: Contest Star Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Obtain all five Generation VI contest Master Ribbons.

ribbons.name: Contest Memory Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Transfer a Pokemon with one or more Generation III or IV Contest Ribbons through Poke Transporter and Pokemon Bank.

variants.name: Gold
variants.requirement: Transfer a Pokemon with all 20 Generation III and all 20 Generation IV Contest Ribbons.

ribbons.name: Skillful Battler Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat a Battle Chatelaine on battle 20 at the Battle Maison.

ribbons.name: Expert Battler Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat a Battle Chatelaine on battle 50 of Super Battles at the Battle Maison.

ribbons.name: Battle Memory Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Transfer a Pokemon with one or more Generation III or IV Battle Tower Ribbons through Poke Transporter and Pokemon Bank.

variants.name: Gold
variants.requirement: Transfer a Pokemon with all eight pre-Generation VI Battle Tower Ribbons.

ribbons.name: Best Friends Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Show a Pokemon with maximum friendship or affection to the appropriate NPC.

ribbons.name: Training Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Show a Supremely Trained Pokemon to the appropriate NPC.

ribbons.name: Alola Champion Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Become Alola Champion and enter the Hall of Fame.

ribbons.name: Battle Royal Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Master Rank Battle Royal.

ribbons.name: Battle Tree Great Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat a Battle Legend at the Battle Tree.

ribbons.name: Battle Tree Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat a Battle Legend in Battle Tree Super Battles.

ribbons.name: Galar Champion Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Become Galar Champion and enter the Hall of Fame.

ribbons.name: Tower Master Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Defeat Leon at MAX Rank in Sword/Shield or Palmer at Master Class Rank 10 in Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl.

ribbons.name: Master Rank Ribbon
ribbons.requirement: Win a Ranked Battle while in Master Ball Tier after reaching MAX Rank in the season.
